- Added skill metadata fields: tags and min_openclaw.
- Improved description to explicitly include voice memos and speech transcripts as supported inputs.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md documentation file.

record2note 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Converts voice recordings into structured Markdown notes compatible with Obsidian, Notion, and similar apps.
- Supports automatic monitoring or manual processing of recordings on macOS and Windows.
- Step-by-step setup wizard guides configuration of vault location, sync method (iCloud, Syncthing, manual), and transcription model.
- Dependency manager handles downloads and installation; detailed progress for large models and platform-specific steps included.
- Features advanced options for diarization, denoise, VAD, agent CLI integration, and more.
- Robust transcription flow with duplicate event protection, file stability checks, and pending directory handling.
